Hi everyone! We’ve started LeanMFG, a Lean 4 library for formalizing mean field game theory and verifying MFG algorithms.

The project is still at an early stage, and we’ve deliberately kept the initial scope small. We’d like community feedback to help decide what to develop next. Would a library like this be useful to your work? Are there particular models, theoretical results, or algorithms you’d be interested in seeing formalized? We’d also appreciate suggestions on the definitions and organization of the library.

https://github.com/Varifold-Lab/LeanMFG
